description: This file is a shell script ('package-mac-app.sh') used for building, bundling, and signing a macOS application package for 'OpenClaw'. It contains build configuration, environment setup, framework merging, resource copying, code signing, and final packaging steps.

methods.name: sparkle_canonical_build_from_version
methods.description: Generates a canonical Sparkle build number from a version string using a TypeScript script.

methods.name: build_path_for_arch
methods.description: Returns the build path for a given architecture.

methods.name: bin_for_arch
methods.description: Returns the binary path for a given architecture and build configuration.

methods.name: sparkle_framework_for_arch
methods.description: Returns the path to the Sparkle framework for a specific architecture.

methods.name: merge_framework_machos
methods.description: Merges Mach-O binaries from multiple frameworks, ensuring all architectures are included in the final binary.
